page.overview:
What is Dig It?

Dig It was released on the Let it Be album on May 8, 1970.

The song has a raunchy feel to it. Many references are made in this particular song. The BBC, FBI, The Rolling Stones, Doris Day, Matt Bubsy, BB King, CIA, were heard in the song. This is the second song to be credited to all four Beatles, the first being Flying from Magical Mystery Tour Phil Spector shortened the song to 51 seconds but the original is 8 minutes.
